name: jacaranda
sourceMesh: Full unreduced original geometry with official photographic diffuse PNG/JPEG and authored embedded RGBA8 leaf alpha
colorSpace: linear RGBA8 albedo, alpha 2x supersampled coverage

positionSpace: model XYZ normalized within sourceBounds; alpha leaf fraction (1 leaf, 0 wood)
